0022600194.text: The Rockets (7-2) are 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West, coming off a loss in their most recent game as they take on the Suns in their 10th game of the season. Phoenix (2-5) is 12th in the West and 4 games back in the Pacific, and it has won its last game. Steven Adams is out for Houston with a calf strain, Clint Capela is day-to-day with an ankle sprain, and Mark Williams is out for Phoenix after shoulder surgery, while Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) are day-to-day for the Suns. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Houston won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-105 in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
